Transannular C–H functionalization of cycloalkane carboxylic acids

Axial partners with great founders and inventors. We invest in early-stage life sciences companies such as Appia Bio, Seranova Bio, Delix Therapeutics, Simcha Therapeutics, among others often when they are no more than an idea.

Transannular C–H functionalization lets chemists reach remote positions on cycloalkane carboxylic acids without classical directing-group gymnastics. Recent methods use metal-catalyzed hydrogen-atom transfer to install valuable handles for downstream diversification in medicinal chemistry.

This note summarizes the inventor story, key papers, and why the reaction class matters for building complex saturated rings that show up in modern clinical candidates and natural-product-inspired screening sets.
